title: Core and modules: organisation, versions and toggles
summary: Modules show their own versions, own their menus and admin areas, and can be switched with clearer dependency checks. False Cloudron addon warnings on the Modules page are fixed.

added: Each module shows its SemVer version; Core shows the release tag on Modules, System status and health checks.
A clearer Modules table with a locked Core row, dependency checks and a detail page for each module.
Release notes can list Core and module versions, with a Module versions table on the change log.
changed: People, Communications, Operations and Help desk menus are owned by each module, so turning a module off removes its items.
Module schedules and HR permissions live with their modules; admin pages use /admin/<slug> paths with redirects from the old URLs.
fixed: The Modules page no longer warns that Cloudron addons look missing when System status shows them as OK.
accessibility: The Modules table and reason dialog are usable with keyboard and screen reader.

internal_notes: Epic #412. Leaves #425–#431. ADR 0001 updated for SemVer and depends_on (HR → learning). Deploy via gh workflow run deploy-cloudron.yml -f tag=v0.6.15.
